name: Crypt (Badlands)
summary: In the Badlands hills, an armored skeleton sits enthroned in a hidden tomb. Urns, chests, and an ancient sword lie beside the silent remains.

sections.title: The Tomb of the Barbarian King
sections.body: Southeast of Hammertoe's Digsite, an unmarked path climbs the hillside to the Crypt. Below, an armored skeleton sits on a stone throne in dark chambers. Beside the remains lies the Sword of the Barbarian King, among bones, urns, and forgotten chests. Miners and travelers search nearby gullies for dwarven ruins and riches, while the seated ruler's origins remain lost to the Badlands.

faq.q: Where is the Crypt located in the Badlands?
faq.answer: The Crypt's entrance lies southeast of Hammertoe's Digsite. An unmarked path climbs the hill above the digsite.

faq.q: Who is the skeleton sitting on the throne inside?
faq.answer: The armored skeleton is known as the Barbarian King. No surviving local texts tell who he was or how he ruled, so his story is lost to the Badlands.

faq.q: What is the sword next to the throne?
faq.answer: The sword is called the Sword of the Barbarian King. It rests beside the skeletal ruler as a grave marker from his warlike past.

faq.q: Are there any quests associated with this crypt?
faq.answer: No customary tasks lead travelers into the crypt. It remains a hidden discovery for those exploring the cliffs.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can pause before a fallen champion who died clad in plate. His mighty blade still lies beside him.
As a dwarf, you find the crypt near active dwarven digsites. Its architecture and skeletal throne point to mysteries from before Ironforge's recent excavations.
